name: Fanatica
source:
The main character, Arshile, has no memory of his past and wanders around Europe with his only acquintance, Cartis. One day, they are unexpectedly invited to a cruise ship called the Fanatica.

"You still don't remember anything? If things stay like this, will the game fail? Or maybe you still haven't found someone who really loves you?"

Words left behind by a mysterious man on the ship.

Soon after this, near the end of their trip, Arshile is kidnapped and wakes up in a palace cut off from the outside world. There, he remembers the sins he committed in the past, the secret of his bloodline and... his deep love for a certain man.

On the night of the lunar eclipse, eternity begins.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110630201932/http://www.orbit-soft.com/core/product/fanatica_story.htm]official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公阿希尔没有过去的记忆，只与唯一的熟人卡蒂斯一同在欧洲四处漂泊。一天，两人意外受邀登上一艘名为“Fanatica”的游轮。

“你还是什么都想不起来吗？这样下去，游戏会失败吗？还是说，你仍未找到真正爱你的人？”

这是船上一名神秘男子留下的话。

不久，在旅程即将结束时，阿希尔遭到绑架，醒来后发现自己身处一座与外界隔绝的宫殿。在那里，他回忆起自己过去犯下的罪、血脉中隐藏的秘密，以及…自己对某个男人深沉的爱。

月食之夜，永恒就此开始。

[翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110630201932/http://www.orbit-soft.com/core/product/fanatica_story.htm]官方网站[/url]]
